text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the academy's annual summer training
camp, and Air Groove has
been spending
the bulk of her training time running on
the beach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew. Twenty kilometers already?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't tire out on the sand as easily
as I used to. When it comes to improving
stamina and core strength,
there's truly no better place
than the beach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention its utility as an
analogue to dirt courses. I'm in better
form than
ever—right now, I don't think I could lose
to anyone. ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dear me.
Is it already time for the festival
to begin?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she did mention she
would be patrolling the
festival on behalf
of the student council tonight.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Students tend to get much too excited at
the festival every year. Someone has to
keep an eye on them for their own
safety; I should
go.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well... as long as you understand that we're going for work and not to fool around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you can promise me that, then sure,
come along.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Cotton candy, takoyaki, candied carrots...
All these sweets can't
possibly be doing
anything positive for the students'
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I seem to recall telling you that we
aren't
here to fool around. Did the
summer sun
fry your brain or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Really, what am I supposed to do with
you... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek! S-stop that, please!

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
I just need a few shots! You're all Tracen
students, right? You're
practically
guaranteed to be future stars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A man who appears to be a tabloid writer
is is taking photos of
students against their
will.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How impudent...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove looks like she's about to
blow a
gasket. I step forward to
do something
about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... No, I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Please keep watch from here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove approaches the scene at a
determined pace.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Did you mention that you were
a journalist?

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-wait... You're the Empress... Air
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure which publication you
represent, but our school requires
all
reporters to obtain permission before
talking to students.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This measure is in place for the
protection
of students' privacy. I trust
you understand
that?

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... I'm sorry. I'm an
Umamusume-centric reporter, you see...

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Racing has been a passion of mine since I
was young, and I guess I
kind of lose
control when I see the runners I admire up
close...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please do know that we are honored to
encounter our fans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But we would all appreciate if you could
adhere to proper etiquette.
Schedule
something official, and you won't
encounter any problems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reporter is easily swayed by Air
Groove's polite admonishing and
quickly
leaves the scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I recall Air Groove's falling-out with her
previous trainer. Would the
Air Groove
from back then have handled this situation
so calmly?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right, that marks the end of my shift,
and everything's in order.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose we could return to the lodge
now, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... Are those fireworks?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In that case, come with me. I know a good
spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shrine commands a panoramic night
view of the city. Away from the hustle and
bustle of the festival, only the sound of
fireworks can
be heard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just like flowers,
fireworks are the product
of much hard work and attention. No
wonder they're a sight to see in full
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Planting a garden in the sky...
It wouldn't
be a simple task, but
someday...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wow... They really are beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reflections from the blooms dazzle in
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, what are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with the sappy expression?
Have you no shame?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The show's finished. Let's head back for
real this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She begins to hasten off, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oof.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The uneven stone surface causes Air
Groove to tumble onto the
ground.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It'll take more than a silly stumble
to...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Actually... Strike that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Will you help me with this shoe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pick up her stray high heel and kneel
before her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
While you're doing that... answer me one
question.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In your eyes... How do you perceive me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then I've been cultivating my own
bloom effectively.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not fully convinced of...
what was that? The greenness of your
thumb?
...Well,
maybe you'll get there eventually.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Continue to work hard, and perhaps you
really can produce a
wonderful crown of
flowers for me, just as I will lead you to
glory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But first, could you please put on my
shoe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove emanates an even more
beautiful air of regality than when
we first
crossed paths.
